safetySheet.title: P7501 Electrical Safety Check (Before Cable Action)
safetySheet.subtitle: Confirm these 4 physical wiring rules once for this session before communicating with the AM34 SoC.
safetySheet.rule3v3Desc: All UART and Flash IC5001 lines operate strictly at 3.3V LVTTL. Never apply 5V signals to AM34.
safetySheet.ruleNsw5vTitle: GP3 / P7501 Pin 5 (NSW5V) = Hi-Z Input Only
safetySheet.ruleNsw5vDesc: Pin 5 receives ~5.15V upstream via D7510 (~3.29V idle). Keep GP3 strictly Hi-Z Input with zero pulls — NEVER push-pull.
safetySheet.ruleXresetDesc: Assert LOW or Hi-Z only; never drive +3.3V push-pull onto XRESET.
safetySheet.ruleBackpowerDesc: Power the Raspberry Pi Pico strictly via USB or VSYS — P7501 Pin 1 is sense only (< 10 mA).
safetySheet.checkboxLabel: I verified my P7501 wiring: 3.3V LVTTL, GP3 NSW5V Hi-Z Input, XRESET Open-Drain, and Pico powered by USB/VSYS.

steps.sdDesc: Unplug AC for 30s, insert card into front SD slot, then reconnect AC power.
steps.readDesc: IPL SDDIAG loads DIGADIAG.FRM into SDRAM cleanly.

steps.f99Desc: Remove the SD card from the front slot cleanly.
steps.swoffDesc: Unplug AC mains briefly, reconnect, and verify normal boot without U99.
